course_name_original: IMPIANTI ELETTRICI E SMART GRID C.I. (B033712)
course_name_en: ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS AND SMART GRIDS C.I.

learning_outcomes.text: Provide basic knowledge for the analysis and design of medium and low voltage electrical systems.
Understand the essential structure of the electrical system.
Distinguish between traditional grids, smart grids, and microgrids.
Evaluate the effects of distributed renewable generation.
Understand the role of storage, electric vehicles, and demand management.
Interpret simple energy profiles and power balances.
Identify energy management strategies for buildings, industries, and energy communities.
Know the fundamental elements of measurement, communication, control, and cybersecurity.
Develop preliminary sizing of a microgrid.

syllabus_topics: Laws and Technical Standards for electrical systems
Equipment and Machines for medium voltage electrical systems
Neutral status in MV distribution networks and user electrical substations
Civil Electrical Systems - Home and Building Automation
teaching_methods: Application lessons regarding the use of software for electrical system design

assessment_methods.method: Written exam on sizing an electrical system in medium and low voltage

assessment_rules: The assessment for passing the exam consists of a written test on the sizing of a medium and low voltage electrical system and an oral test. The two tests will take place on the same exam day. Grades range from 'Insufficient' (negative evaluation due to serious conceptual errors) to '29-30 cum Laude' (excellent evaluation due to complete, in-depth, and well-structured knowledge). Laude is awarded for brilliant and original work or performance.
